distance_provenance.variety_merge_zone_m: TRAIN observable merge-zone projection (tools/coopfree/selection.py features zone)

what_it_does.groups: decision_groups() ADDS groups (registered chain groups stay first and unchanged): (a) wall = registered chaining/window rules re-run with chain_m = variety_wall_span_m, keeping components spanning >= variety_wall_min_lanes distinct lanes; (b) gap_open = ramp CAVs inside the observable merge zone + the mainline CAVs within variety_gap_link_m they would merge into. Duplicate member sets dropped; committed-plan exclusion applies as before. Wired at ls_collection.install, replay_bank.collector_guide and mppi_runtime.plan (the GPU side re-derives the same kinds from the record's search_config variety keys).
what_it_does.generators: Structured candidates take ordinary population slots (total N, batch widths and WM cost unchanged): WALL = abreast members synchronise to the group mean observable speed, decelerate together at a sampled depth for a sampled hold, then release (open-loop profile of the wall v2.1 pace law clip((target-v)/dt, lo, hi), integrated from observable v0 like centre_feasibility); GAP_OPEN = a mainline member eases ahead of the ramp partner's geometric predicted arrival, then recovers; RAMP_ASSIST = the mainline CAV ahead eases and the ramp CAV synchronises to the eased speed in a sampled offset window. onset/hold/depth/duration/members sampled per candidate from a dedicated child stream of the search seed; every profile goes through the SAME build_plan bounds+feasibility clamp (policy_duplicate rule intact).
what_it_does.cap: at most floor(variety_structured_share * population) structured slots per search (per niche in niche mode); free search keeps the majority; nothing guarantees a structured candidate in the finalists or top-8 - the WM score and SUMO decide.
what_it_does.r_fairness: sample_unscored draws from the SAME family mix under the SAME registered keys (share honoured by the same draw, dedicated stream, byte-identical fallback when the config is absent); random_candidates passes the snapshot meta's variety_config (collector writes it for arm R).
what_it_does.tags: every searched candidate carries variety_family in (free, wall, gap_open, ramp_assist) - additive key only when the option is on. It rides inside plan dicts into SUMO branch specs and receipts; variety.family_counts() counts verified/admitted per family from receipt directories.
what_it_does.novelty: coop_search novelty enabling from config was ALREADY possible: c4/coop-search-fix2 IS merged into c4/v2v-resume (verified: both branches contain a68174f4/74f8ae81). Enabling = LS_COOP_SEARCH_CONFIG.json (or the replay binding search_config) with coop_objective/coop_novelty/coop_novelty_bank_sha256; the bank-descriptor file is handled by the existing preflight: coop_search preflight CLI + ls_collection.preflight_coop at supervisor startup, and this feature adds the same preflight to the replay-bank collector (replay_bank.preflight_binding, called at collect() startup). GPU hosts resolve the bank from $COOPMWM_COOP_BANK_DIR or BANK_DIRS.

how_to_enable.ls_collection_batch: write LS_VARIETY_CONFIG.json into the collection root: {"variety": {<registered variety_* keys, variety_families: true>}}. The supervisor reads it after LS_COOP_SEARCH_CONFIG.json, attaches it to collection jobs (install-time decision groups) and to every admitted search_config (search_config(ordinal, coop, alternate, variety)); without niche alternation it attaches the registered it2_K2 config plus the variety keys so the GPU side re-derives the same groups.
how_to_enable.replay_bank_batch: add "variety": {<registered keys, variety_families: true>} to the collector binding: collect() copies it into job['collect'] (collector_guide decision groups + snapshot meta variety_config for arm R). For the B arm search, put the same variety_* keys into binding['search_config'] (or the record's search_config) - validated by niche_collect.validate.
how_to_enable.gpu_side: no extra step: the record's search_config variety keys drive both the additive group lookup (mppi_runtime.plan) and the structured injection (mppi_search.search/_niche_search).
how_to_enable.bank_reports: variety.family_counts(<bank>/sumo_verification) counts verified/admitted candidates per family from the sealed receipts (legacy receipts without the tag are not counted).
